bio_en: Nikol Harutiunian was born in 1883 in Ashan in the Varanda district of Karabakh and joined the ARF in 1902. During the Armenian-Tatar clashes he fought in Baku, the North Caucasus and Karabakh; arrested, he escaped to Vladikavkaz, where he worked as an ARF operative and was the most skilful at moving arms. In Persia he became one of the band commanders in Yeprem's force. He was killed beside Yeprem in 1912, 'the unconquerable among the unconquerable'.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
